description: This file defines the EntityEcaHandler interface, which specifies methods and constants for handling entity event conditions and rules within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityEcaHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling entity event condition actions, including setting the delegator, retrieving event maps, and evaluating rules based on specific operations and events.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the Delegator instance used by the handler.

methods.name: getEntityEventMap
methods.description: Retrieves a map of entity event lists based on the entity name.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates the rules associated with a specific operation and event, given the current entity value and error state.
